'''Lancaster University School of Mathematics''', also known as '''LUSoM''', is a [[maths school]] located in [[Preston, Lancashire|Preston]], [[Lancashire]], England.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=New images reveal how Lancaster University School of Mathematics will look |url=https://www.lancaster.ac.uk/maths/about-us/news/new-images-reveal-how-lancaster-university-school-of-mathematics-will-look |access-date=2022-04-13 |website=www.lancaster.ac.uk |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Lancaster University to launch specialist maths school for teenagers who 'live and breathe' the subject |url=https://www.lancasterguardian.co.uk/education/lancaster-university-to-launch-specialist-maths-school-for-teenagers-who-live-and-breathe-the-subject-3176200 |access-date=2022-04-13 |website=www.lancasterguardian.co.uk |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Lancaster University School of Mathematics |url=https://www.cardinalnewman.ac.uk/home-2-2/lancaster-university-school-maths/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Cardinal Newman College |language=en}}</ref><ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=New specialist maths school coming to Preston |url=https://www.blogpreston.co.uk/2021/06/new-specialist-maths-school-coming-to-preston/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |website=Blog Preston |language=en-en}}</ref> As a maths school, it is a specialist [[mathematics]] [[Free school (England)|free school]] [[sixth form college]].

The school was set up by the Rigby Education Trust,<ref>{{Cite web |title=THE RIGBY EDUCATION TRUST - GOV.UK |url=https://get-information-schools.service.gov.uk/Groups/Group/Details/17452 |access-date=2022-09-12 |website=get-information-schools.service.gov.uk |language=en}}</ref> a single-academy trust set up in partnership between the [[Lancaster University]] and [[Cardinal Newman College]] for the purpose of opening and operating the school.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lancaster School of Mathematics is given the green light |date=18 August 2021 |url=http://www.nwconstructionhub.org/news/lancaster-school-of-mathematics-is-given-the-green-light/ |access-date=2022-04-07 |language=en-US}}</ref> It opened to students in September 2022<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lancaster University School of Mathematics - GOV.UK |url=https://get-information-schools.service.gov.uk/Establishments/Establishment/Details/149099 |access-date=2022-09-12 |website=get-information-schools.service.gov.uk |language=en}}</ref> and is located in a £8.5 million school building on London Road, Preston,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Lancaster University School of Mathematics, Preston, Lancashire |url=https://lusom.ac.uk/ |access-date=2022-04-06 |website=Lancaster University School of Mathematics |language=en-GB}}</ref><ref name=":2" /> and is the first purpose-built specialist Maths School in the UK.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Smythe |first=Kirsty |date=2023-09-22 |title=LUSoM celebrated the official opening of the UK's first purpose-built specialist Maths school on Friday 22nd September |url=https://lusom.ac.uk/lancaster-university-school-of-mathematics-celebrates-their-grand-opening/ |access-date=2023-12-10 |website=Lancaster University School of Mathematics |language=en-GB |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231210181513if_/https://lusom.ac.uk/lancaster-university-school-of-mathematics-celebrates-their-grand-opening/ |archive-date=2023-12-10}}</ref>

The school is highly selective, with prospective students expected to have [[General Certificate of Secondary Education|GCSE]] mathematics qualification at grade 8 or 9 and required to sit an admissions assessment.<ref name=":1" />  The course structure at LUSoM requires all students to study [[A-level]] Mathematics and Further Mathematics and a third A-level from either Physics, Chemistry or Computer Science. In addition, students may select a fourth subject from those three, or choose any other A-level subject to be taught at [[Cardinal Newman College]], which is located less than half a mile from the school site.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Study |url=https://lusom.ac.uk/study/ |access-date=2022-04-06 |website=Lancaster University School of Mathematics |language=en-GB}}</ref>
